description: National Full-Scale Testing Infrastructure for Community Hardening in Extreme Wind, Surge, and Wave Events (NICHE): Legacy Field Data Inventory is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Frank Lombardo, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (illinois.edu). This project presents a legacy field observation inventory of windstorms (e.g., hurricanes, tropical storms, tornadoes, severe storms) that occurred in the Atlantic Ocean and in the United States from 1880 and 2021. Coverage: Atlantic Ocean and in US. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Hurricane, Windstorm, Wind Speed, Rainfall, Pressure, Surge. Published 2023-03-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
